column4: Asserts the invariant that a just-created task serves no backend output (a debug assertion, counted in tests); it refuses nothing in a release build (MIK-8392 F3)
Writes the idp_refuse audit record for a busy custody; it decides no answer and admits nothing
A read-only peek delegating to admission's already_admitted, so the intake can tell a repeat from a new task call; admission's begin re-decides and admits nothing here
Returns the PropagationError a MintError carries for callers that do not distinguish a busy custody; it decides nothing
Wraps a PropagationError as MintError::Other, the classification every non-custody refusal already had; it decides nothing
